summary: Master Lean Six Sigma for service and office processes to reduce waste, cut delays, and improve control. Enrol in practical 5-day training.
lede: Lean Six Sigma for service and office processes helps teams measure and improve transactional workflows. It is designed for professionals working with service, administrative, or shared-service processes who need a structured way to diagnose delays, rework, and defects. Learners practice measuring performance, mapping service flows, analyzing root causes, balancing queues, and creating control plans with methods such as DMAIC, SIPOC, Pareto analysis, and control charts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with service, administrative, or shared-service processes and need practical Lean Six Sigma methods for measurable improvement.
modules: Six Sigma analysis for service variation
Lean Six Sigma reporting and sustainment
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and a real service or office process example from your work. If available, bring defect logs, SLA reports, queue data, or process maps; no coding or statistical software is required.
